# PhotoSwipe 4.1.0

These files are the official PhotoSwipe 4.1.0 release, vendored so the gallery does not load JavaScript from a third-party CDN.

- Upstream: https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe/releases/tag/v4.1.0
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this folder)
- Files: `photoswipe.css`, `photoswipe.min.js`, `photoswipe-ui-default.min.js`, and `default-skin/`

The site does not use the PhotoSwipe 5 package that used to be listed in `package.json`. That unused dependency was removed.
